hints.title: Prime State Validity
hints.text: Notice that if either the starting number or target number is prime, no valid sequence can begin or terminate.

hints.title: Transition Graph
hints.text: Each state can transition by incrementing or decrementing any single digit without introducing leading zeros or primes.

hints.title: Cost Minimization
hints.text: Use a priority queue to explore paths with lowest accumulated values, returning minimal cost once target is popped.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Shortest path search with priority queue over non-prime states of identical digit length.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Unweighted search does not account for accumulated node value costs.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(V) sieve array and distance lookup table.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Precomputes primes using a sieve and finds minimal path cost using a priority queue.
